content: python-docx 1.2.0 already exposes document.sections[i].header / .footer / .even_page_header / .first_page_header. For footnotes/endnotes (no public API), access doc.part.rels.values() to find the footnotes part then traverse via lxml (the OxmlElement escape hatch in python-docx source). This is the documented pattern, no extra library needed. python-docx-ng fork exists but is not actively maintained; stick with python-openxml/python-docx upstream 1.2.0.
